shortBio.en: Fontaines D.C. vocalist; spoken-sung delivery over post-punk guitar.
shortBio.zh: Fontaines D.C. 主唱；后朋克吉他上的说唱式咬字。

body.en: Born 1995. Lead vocals and lyric focus for Fontaines D.C. from Dogrel onward. Delivery sits between spoken cadence and sung hooks.
body.zh: 1995 年生。从《Dogrel》起 Fontaines D.C. 主唱与歌词重心。唱法介于口语节奏与副歌旋律之间。
